firmware: STM32 branch fix/testing-report-24-09-26; ESP-01 web app branch fix/device-sync
terms: Read from 4 probes (25%, 50%, 75%, 100%). A level must be stable for 5 s before it is accepted. If a wireless tank transmitter is paired, its level is used and the last received value is kept during short signal gaps.
Sensor that shows whether water is actually flowing from the source.
How long the motor runs as a test before the dry run sensor is checked (setting "Dry Run", default 2 min).
How long the motor waits after a failed dry run test before trying again (default 30 min).
How many failed dry run tests are allowed before the motor waits for the next trigger (default 5; 0 = unlimited).
Sensor that shows whether ground-water supply is present. A change is accepted only after it has lasted 10 s.
An event that is allowed to start / stop the motor in a mode.
After power-up the motor never starts in the first 10 s.

modules.name: General behaviour
rules: Tank level comes from the 4 level probes; a new level is accepted only after it is stable for 5 s.
If a wireless tank transmitter is paired, its level is used; during a signal gap the last received level is kept.
After power-up the motor never starts during the first 10 s.
A ground water change (YES/NO) is accepted only after it has lasted 10 s.
All settings (limits, timer slots, twist, buzzer, countdown time, power restore, last mode) are kept through power cuts and firmware updates.
The clock keeps running during a power cut on its backup battery, and is not changed by firmware updates.
Relay 2 gives a 2 s pulse when the motor starts and relay 3 a 2 s pulse when it stops (for an external starter panel).

modules.name: Device buttons
modules.note: Buttons from left: 1 = Refill/Reset (red), 2 = Select "P" (yellow), 3 = Up, 4 = Down. Long press = hold 2 s.
rules: Button 1 short press: Refill start / stop. Long press: Manual on / off.
Button 2 short press: Auto on / Auto off (motor off). Long press: open the menu.
Button 3 short press: Timer mode on / off. Long press: Semi-Auto on / off.
Button 4 short press: Countdown start (saved time) / stop. Long press: edit the countdown time.
Twist mode is started and stopped from Menu > Twist Mode or from the app.
Quick taps are always registered; in menus and edit screens holding Up/Down repeats the step and speeds up after 3 s. On the dashboard holding a button never acts as repeated short presses.

modules.name: Auto mode
rules: Auto is started with button 2 or from the app.
When no mode is running and the level goes below 50% (25%), the device starts Auto by itself - unless the user switched Auto or Manual off with its button.
Motor ON when the level goes below 50%. The probes read 0/25/50/75/100%, so the motor starts at 25% (see DEC-08).
Motor OFF when the tank is full (100%).
Ground water detected (NO to YES): motor ON if the level is at or below 75%.
Ground water lost (YES to NO) while running: motor OFF, then waits the testing gap (see DEC-09).
Dry run enabled: after the dry run time the sensor is checked; water found - motor keeps running until the tank is full.
Dry run enabled, no water: motor OFF, waits the testing gap, then tries again.
After the retry count is used up, the motor waits for the next on key (ground water detected, Refill button, or the user).
Button 2 while Auto is running: motor OFF, screen shows "AUTO M:OFF". This still counts as Auto for power restore.
Voltage, current and max run protections stop the motor (see Protections).
Other on keys: Refill button (the tank is filled, then Auto continues), the testing gap ending after a dry run failure, and power restore (see PWR-02).

modules.name: Manual mode
rules: Manual is started with a long press of button 1 or from the app.
In Manual only the user (button or app) can switch the motor ON.
Motor OFF by: user, voltage fault, over/under current, max run time, power off.
Tank full does NOT stop the motor in Manual; the tank-full buzzer sounds for 30 s if enabled.
Dry run and ground water are not used in Manual.

When a protection (voltage, current, max run) trips, the motor stops and the device stays in Manual - screen shows MANUAL with the motor off. Only the user's press starts it again; Auto does not start by itself.

modules.name: Timer mode
rules: Up to 5 time slots, each with an ON time, OFF time and its own days of the week; a slot can be switched off.
Timer is started with button 3 or from the app (Save & Start Timer). The Refill button also starts the motor (see Refill).
Motor ON when the clock enters an active slot (right time and right day).
Motor OFF at the slot's OFF time.
Outside every slot the motor stays OFF; ground water and dry run are ignored.
Inside a slot, ground water detected: motor ON.
Inside a slot, ground water lost: motor OFF, then waits the testing gap (see DEC-09).
Dry run enabled: same test / testing gap / retry count as Auto.
While running, if the dry run sensor shows no water, the motor stops and waits the testing gap.
Tank full: motor OFF; it starts again as soon as the level drops below 100% while the slot is active (see decision DEC-01).
A slot switched off in the app or on the device stays off after saving and after a reboot.

modules.name: Twist mode
rules: Twist is started / stopped from Menu > Twist Mode or from the app. Settings: ON duration, OFF duration (minutes), optional start and stop time.
ON period: motor ON for the ON duration. OFF period: motor OFF for the OFF duration. Then repeats.
Twist runs only between its start and stop time; if both are equal it runs all day.
Dry run enabled: tested at the start of every ON period; water found - motor runs the rest of the ON period.
Dry run enabled, no water: motor OFF for the rest of that ON period; the OFF period follows and the next ON period tests again. Twist does not stop.
If the ON duration is shorter than the dry run time, the check is made at the end of the ON period.
Ground water lost (YES to NO): motor OFF until ground water returns, then a new ON period starts.
If the ground water probe is not fitted (always NO), Twist ignores it.
Tank full: motor OFF; Twist restarts (with an ON period) only when the level is at or below 25%.
Twist settings are saved and kept after a reboot.

Power restore ON: if twist was running at power loss, it continues the same ON or OFF period with the time it had left (saved every minute, so up to 1 min may be repeated) - only inside its start/stop time.

modules.name: Semi-Auto mode
rules: Semi-Auto is started with a long press of button 3 or from the app (only the user has the on key); it is a single run to fill the tank.
Off keys: button 3 long press again, tank full (100%). The motor does not restart by itself.
Dry run enabled, no water after the dry run time: motor OFF and Semi-Auto ends.
Voltage / current faults and max run time stop the motor and end Semi-Auto.
Power restore ON: if the Semi-Auto motor was running at power loss, Semi-Auto runs again when power returns.

modules.name: Countdown mode
rules: Countdown runs the motor for a set time (1-180 min, default 10 min); started with button 4 or from the app.

Motor OFF when the time ends or the user stops it (button 4 or app). However the countdown ends, the mode that was running before it (e.g. Auto, Timer, Twist, Manual, or Auto switched off with button 2) continues and is shown on the screen.
While a countdown runs, the screen always shows the time left - also when it was started from the app or resumed after a power cut.
Tank full (100%): the countdown ends and the previous mode continues.
The time is set with a long press of button 4 (Down +1, Up -1, Select). It is saved and used by every later button 4 press; a time set in the app is also saved as the button time.
Dry run enabled, no water after the dry run time: Countdown ends.
Voltage and current faults and max run time end the countdown; the previous mode continues.

Power restore ON: a countdown running at power loss continues with the time it had left (saved every minute, so up to 1 min may be repeated). When it ends, the mode that was running before it continues - this is also kept in memory.

modules.name: Refill
rules: Refill is not a mode: it is a motor start button usable in any mode. The screen shows "Refill" while it runs; afterwards the mode from before continues.
Refill is started with a short press of button 1 or from the app; it is not started if the tank is already full.
Tank full: Refill ends and the previous mode (e.g. Auto) continues.
Refill is stopped by the user (button 1) and by max run time; the previous mode continues.
Dry run enabled, no water: Refill ends and the previous mode continues.
Voltage / current fault: Refill ends and the previous mode continues.
Power cut during Refill: after power returns the device is in the mode from before Refill; that mode's power restore rule applies (see DEC-11).

modules.name: Protections
rules: Low / high voltage (default 180 V / 280 V): voltage outside the limits for 3 s stops the motor; it is checked all the time, so a bad supply also prevents a start. Recovers after 10 s back in range (Manual stays off until the user starts it).
Over-load current (default 25 A): above the limit for 3 s stops the motor; the first 3 s after a start are ignored. Auto, Timer and Twist may restart after the testing gap.
Under-load current (default off): below the limit for 3 s stops the motor; Auto, Timer and Twist may restart after the testing gap.

Max run time (default 150 min) applies in every mode: after running this long the motor stops. Refill and Countdown end (previous mode continues), Semi-Auto ends, Manual stays shown with the motor off; Auto, Timer and Twist may run again after the testing gap.
A limit of 0 (or switched off in the app) disables that protection.
Voltage and current can be calibrated from the app against a meter reading; with no load the current shows 0.0 A.

modules.name: Power restore
rules: Device Setup > PwrRestore has two values: ON and OFF (factory default OFF).
ON, last mode Auto (motor ON, or switched off with button 2): after power returns - Auto, motor ON after 10 s; stays OFF if the tank is full.
ON, last mode Manual: Manual, motor OFF (one long press of button 1 starts it).
ON, last mode Timer: Timer; the motor starts if the clock is inside an active slot.
ON, last mode Twist: continues the same period with the time it had left (see TWS-11).
ON, last mode Countdown: continues with the time it had left (see CD-07). Semi-Auto: runs again if its motor was running (SEMI-06). Refill: see REF-06.
OFF: after power returns always Manual, motor OFF.

modules.name: Buzzer
rules: Pump on: beeps once per second while the motor runs (if enabled).
Tank full: buzzer for 30 s (if enabled).
Tank empty (level reaches 0%): buzzer for 15 s (if enabled).
Each buzzer can be switched on/off separately; all are off by default.

modules.name: Display
rules: Line 1: mode, motor state and level, e.g. "AUTO   M:ON  50%".
Line 2: G.W:YES/NO, "DRY" when the dry run sensor shows no water, and the time; "TANK FULL" when full.
Page 2: voltage, current and day, or the active fault (voltage / overload / underload error).

modules.name: Factory reset
rules: Factory reset (menu or app) sets: dry run disabled (2 min), testing gap 30 min, max run 150 min, retry count 5, low/high voltage 180/280 V, over-load 25 A, under-load disabled, power restore OFF, buzzer all off, countdown 10 min, timer slots and twist cleared.

modules.name: Web app (ESP-01)
rules: Every app page (settings, timer, twist, countdown) shows the values currently stored on the device, not app defaults.
If the device does not answer, the page says so and shows the last known values.
Apply Settings saves on the device and the page reloads the values the device confirmed.
Status (motor, level, mode) updates within about 3 s.
Timer page sends all 5 slots; has Save & Start and Stop Timer.
Twist page shows saved settings and running state; has Save & Start and Stop Twist; durations in minutes.
Countdown page shows a countdown that is already running on the device.
Settings page has separate buzzer switches (pump on, tank full, tank empty), power restore ON/OFF and factory reset.

decisions: DEC-01
Timer after tank full
Now: motor restarts as soon as the level drops below 100% while the slot is active. Auto and Twist wait for 25%.
(a) Keep as now   (b) Restart only at 25% or below
DEC-03
Automatic Auto when idle
Now: when no mode is running and the level goes below 50% (25%), the device starts Auto by itself (not when Auto or Manual was switched off with its button).
(a) Keep as now   (b) Never start Auto by itself
DEC-04
Retry count used up
Now: after all dry run retries fail, the motor waits for ground water or the user.
(a) Keep as now   (b) Retry again after a longer gap - give time
DEC-05
Current fault recovery
Now: after an over/under-current trip the motor may restart after the testing gap (default 30 min).
(a) Keep as now   (b) Different time - give time   (c) Only the user restarts
DEC-06
Starter relays
Now: relay 2 = 2 s pulse at motor start, relay 3 = 2 s pulse at motor stop.
(a) Correct   (b) Different wiring - describe
DEC-07
Twist days
Now: the app lets you pick days for Twist but the device runs Twist every day.
(a) Every day is fine   (b) Add day selection
DEC-08
Auto start level
The Key Story says the motor starts when the level goes below 50%. The probes read 0/25/50/75/100%, so this is 25%. Now: the motor starts at 25%.
(a) 25% (below 50%)   (b) 50%   (c) 50% the first time, 25% after the tank was filled
DEC-09
Ground water lost

The first testing report made ground water lost an off key in Auto and Timer; the Key Story does not list it. Now: the motor stops 10 s after ground water is lost and tries again after the testing gap.
(a) Keep: ground water lost stops the motor   (b) Remove: ground water only starts the motor
DEC-10
Resume after a power cut
Semi-Auto, Countdown and Twist continue after a power cut. Now: only when Power Restore = ON; with OFF the device starts in Manual with the motor off.
(a) Only with Power Restore ON   (b) Always
DEC-11
Refill + power cut, previous mode Auto, Power Restore ON
Refill rule: motor off after power restore. Auto rule: motor starts again. Now: the Auto rule applies (motor starts after 10 s unless the tank is full).
(a) Motor stays OFF until Auto's next on key   (b) Auto rule: motor starts
history: First issue for client approval. Includes the fixes from testing report 24-09-26.

Updated to the client's "Key Story" (on/off keys per mode): Auto starts below 50% (25%); Refill is not a mode and returns to the previous mode (also after a fault or power cut); Manual stays shown after a protection trip; Semi-Auto, Countdown and Twist continue after a power cut; Countdown ends at tank full and at max run and returns to the previous mode; Timer starts after a power cut inside an active slot. New open points DEC-08 to DEC-11.
